name: print-social-successful-projects-stats-post-with-violet-glass-tiles
title: 'Invented and managed successful projects' stats post with offset rows of violet glass tiles
whatItIs: A square violet post with a white X logo, a two-tone headline, and three offset rows of frosted violet glass tiles with fine grids showing big numbers and labels (52 Successful launches, 150 Interviews conducted, 250+ People hired), fading toward the bottom, plus a split 'Book a meeting' CTA.
whatItMeans: Impressive and tactile; staggered stats feel like an endless wall of achievements.
techniques: Offset rows of stat tiles like bricks.
Fade lower rows to suggest more.
Put a fine grid inside each glass tile.
Pair big numerals with small labels.

vocabulary.definition: A card showing a number and label.
